name: Josh Durey
description: When AI grading or AI practice tests get scores wrong, the bug is usually a rubric written for humans. I test where AI graders break and rewrite the rubrics and checks so you can trust the scores.
heroHeadline: When AI grading or AI practice tests get scores wrong, swapping the model rarely fixes it.
thesis: Most AI graders fail because the rubric was written for human readers. Unstated gaps let wordy bluffing earn credit while terse right answers lose points. I test where your AI grader or question bank breaks, then rewrite the rubrics and checks so you can trust the scores.
